title: [Feature Flag Smith Feature Tasks Kanban Enabled Prd] Awaiting Approval lane for review queue
description: As an operator, I want validated tasks grouped in one lane so I can approve the next work item efficiently.
problem_statement: Validated tasks are not clearly grouped for operator review, causing slower and inconsistent approval flow.
objectives: Surface all validated tasks in a single, dedicated Kanban lane.
Reduce operator time to identify the next task to approve.
Preserve existing task states and transitions outside the new lane behavior.
non_goals: Adding new approval roles or permissions.
Redesigning the full Kanban board layout beyond the new lane.

in_scope: Render an 'Awaiting Approval' lane when feature flag is enabled.
Move validated tasks into the 'Awaiting Approval' lane.
Keep lane ordering deterministic for operator review.

stories.title: Show Awaiting Approval lane behind feature flag
stories.i_want: the Kanban board to display an 'Awaiting Approval' lane only when the feature flag is enabled
stories.so_that: I can use the new review queue without affecting users when disabled
acceptance_criteria: Given the feature flag is enabled, when an operator loads the board, then an 'Awaiting Approval' lane is visible.
Given the feature flag is disabled, when an operator loads the board, then the 'Awaiting Approval' lane is not visible.
Toggling the feature flag does not change unrelated lane visibility.

stories.title: Group validated tasks into Awaiting Approval lane
stories.i_want: all validated tasks to appear in one lane
stories.so_that: I can process approvals from a single queue
acceptance_criteria: Given tasks are in validated state and the feature flag is enabled, when the board loads, then each validated task appears in 'Awaiting Approval'.
Given a task is not validated, when the board loads, then it does not appear in 'Awaiting Approval'.
A validated task appears only once on the board.

stories.title: Keep stable ordering for review priority
stories.so_that: I can approve the next work item efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Given multiple validated tasks, when displayed in 'Awaiting Approval', then ordering follows configured priority (highest priority first, tie by oldest validation timestamp).
Refreshing the board preserves ordering for unchanged task data.
Newly validated tasks are inserted according to the same ordering rules.

stories.title: Update lane membership after approval decision
stories.i_want: approved or rejected tasks to leave the Awaiting Approval lane immediately
stories.so_that: the queue always reflects pending review work
acceptance_criteria: Given a task in 'Awaiting Approval', when it is approved, then it is removed from 'Awaiting Approval' and shown in its next state lane.
Given a task in 'Awaiting Approval', when it is rejected, then it is removed from 'Awaiting Approval' and shown in its next state lane.
Lane counts update to match displayed cards after each decision.

stories.title: Handle empty Awaiting Approval state
stories.i_want: a clear empty state when no validated tasks exist
stories.so_that: I can quickly confirm there is nothing pending approval
acceptance_criteria: Given feature flag is enabled and no validated tasks exist, when the board loads, then 'Awaiting Approval' displays an empty-state message.
Given at least one validated task exists, when the board loads, then the empty-state message is not shown.
The empty-state message does not block board interactions in other lanes.

success_metrics: Median time from board load to first approval action decreases by 20%.
At least 95% of validated tasks appear in 'Awaiting Approval' within one board refresh cycle.
Operator-reported clarity for approval queue improves in post-release survey.
risks: Incorrect state mapping could hide validated tasks.
Ordering logic disagreements may cause perceived priority issues.
Feature flag misconfiguration may expose incomplete behavior.
dependencies: Task state machine emitting reliable 'validated' status and timestamps.
Kanban board API includes fields required for ordering.

blockers.description: Cannot run local git-hook CI workflow via act because both `act` and `docker` are unavailable in this environment.
